title: Proof Burden Standard
purpose: Separate architectural completion from evidentiary completion. Every principle carries an explicit burden of proof so readers and contributors can see remaining work.
operating_rule: Advance the proof before expanding the architecture. Every packet must be capable of disproving the doctrine it examines.
bottleneck_note: Creativity is no longer the binding constraint. Scholarship — verifying, modeling, testing, and documenting — is the bottleneck. That is a good sign.

standard.applies_to: Every principle intended for eventual manuscript or public-policy use

architecture_vs_evidence.architecture_complete_means: IDs, frameworks, surfaces, and cross-links exist and validate
architecture_vs_evidence.evidence_complete_means: Proof categories are closed or honestly scoped; Proof Packets graduated through historical, economic, and constitutional/legal layers
architecture_vs_evidence.rule: Architectural completion never implies evidentiary completion

honesty_rules: Three baseline claims do not constitute a comprehensive evidentiary dossier
Illustrative design parameters (e.g., purchase floors, multipliers) remain hypotheses until modeled
No invented citations, statistics, or modeled results
Phase 2 remains PARTIAL until canonical acceptance checklist passes
Architecture Candidate / Hypothesis Card principles are not publishable until Proof Packets graduate
Packets seek contrary evidence and non-adoption conditions, not confirmation alone
Architecture revision recommended by evidence is governance success, not project failure

principles.title: Local Food and Family Farm Prosperity
architecture_summary: Doctrine IDs, framework, IA node, book/board surfaces, and cross-links are integrated
Initial empirical anchors registered: USDA ERS family-farm structure, FNS Farm to School, AMS LAMP (CC-CLAIM-124–126)
evidence_summary: Architecture is not yet validated as public policy
Institutional assumptions (purchase targets, prosperity dividends, community food accounts, multipliers) remain hypotheses requiring modeling and legal analysis
Three baseline claims are a starting evidence base, not a comprehensive dossier

proof_burden.note: Farm-to-school and local-market programs exist; not a finished historical synthesis for the full thirteen-pillar system.
ERS/FNS/AMS anchors and related literatures exist; regenerative economics, hub economics, and multiplier claims not yet dossiered.
Farm-to-school and LAMP-style tools are pilots/programs in the wild; CC-specific Prosperity Fund / Food Utility designs are not piloted as specified.
Modeling 0%; purchase floors and fund formulas remain illustrative.
Stewardship and regenerative outcome evidence not yet packeted.
Regional food utility governance and inspection/standard administration pending.

priority_evidence_packets.title: Local Food and Family Farm Prosperity
Community economic multipliers
priority_evidence_packets.honesty_note: Do not invent multiplier constants. Measure and cite.

principles.graduation_target: Defensible public-policy posture for CC-PRIN-44 requires material progress on these five packets plus constitutional/fiscal categories — not architectural expansion.

queue_rule.then: Apply the same Proof Burden table to other Architecture Candidate principles (CC-PRIN-45–47) without minting new principles
queue_rule.burt_priority_unchanged: Burt steps 2→3/4→5→6→8→9→10 remain the Phase 2 spine; PRIN-44 packets are the incubator scholarship track for HYP-116

research_program_mode.transition_note: CC-DEC-102 is the crossing from vision to discipline. The project is no longer primarily writing Constitutional Capitalism — it is conducting research into whether Constitutional Capitalism, as currently architected, withstands rigorous scrutiny.
research_program_mode.success_question: Can we prove what we already have?

investigator_philosophy.text: The objective is not to defend the architecture. The objective is to discover the truth about the architecture.
investigator_philosophy.identity_shift: Until CC-DEC-102, architectural effort. Beginning with CC-DEC-102, a constitutional research program.
investigator_philosophy.norm_protects: The integrity of everything that follows — the framework exists to discover the truth about its architecture, not to defend it.
implications: The research team is not an advocate; it is an investigator
Doctrine is not presumed correct because it exists
Doctrine must continuously earn its place through evidence
There is no protect-the-doctrine outcome — only accurately characterize what the evidence says

verdict_meanings.qualifies: doctrine becomes more precise and robust
verdict_meanings.contradicts: architecture improves because it is willing to correct itself — revise or explicitly explain

investigator_philosophy.success_is: a healthy mix of Supports / Qualifies / Contradicts under honest evidence — integrity over rigidity

scholarship_five_questions.rule: Every proof packet should answer these five questions consistently.
questions: What does the strongest supporting evidence show?
What does the strongest contrary evidence show?
Under what conditions would this doctrine fail or require qualification?
What is the honest verdict: Supports, Qualifies, or Contradicts?
scholarship_five_questions.outcome: A body of constitutional scholarship — not a traditional policy platform.

pp_ff_01_methodology_role.role: Validation of the Constitutional Capitalism research methodology — not merely the first family-farm packet
pp_ff_01_methodology_role.if_executed_well: Every later proof packet can say: this conclusion was reached using the same transparent, repeatable methodology.
pp_ff_01_methodology_role.value: Methodology validation is more valuable than proving any single doctrine.

phase_2_method_legacy.lasting_contribution_may_be: the method for evaluating constitutional, economic, and civic ideas
method_elements: governance that requires evidence to earn authority
phase_2_method_legacy.architectural_chapter: closed — devote energy to making the methodology as rigorous and reproducible as the architecture

chapter_closing_note.text: The credibility of Constitutional Capitalism will ultimately rest less on the originality of its ideas than on the transparency of how those ideas survive scrutiny.
chapter_closing_note.historian_closing_paragraph: The Architecture Chapter established the structure of Constitutional Capitalism. The Research Chapter begins the process of determining whether that structure is true, qualified, or should be revised. From this point forward, progress is measured not by the number of ideas created, but by the number of hypotheses honestly tested. The framework will earn credibility through transparent inquiry rather than assertion.
chapter_closing_note.shift: Many frameworks ask people to trust the authors. This methodology asks people to inspect the process.
inspectable: the reasoning that led to the verdict
pp_ff_01_if_successful_establishes: The governance model functions as designed
chapter_closing_note.after_pp_ff_01: Repetition — not reinvention. Each new packet applies the same disciplined process to a different part of the framework.

operational_state.next_milestone: PP-02 / register contrary literature — PP-FF-01 executive draft Qualifies

chapter_closing_note.momentum_from: steadily converting architectural hypotheses into well-supported, well-qualified, or honestly contradicted conclusions — not adding more concepts

proof_packet_operating_system.summary: Canonical Proof Packet OS: template, JSON contract, verdict/confidence standards, lifecycle, checklist, methodology audit, registry, automated validation. No doctrine changes.

pp_ff_01_execution.summary: First executive packet. Descriptive federal baselines support narrow predicates; full HYP-116 comparative prosperity claim unproven. Architecture and principles unchanged. OS validated in practice.

methodology_calibration.summary: Methodology improved from PP-FF-01 weaknesses (contrary external sources, confidence split, decision tree). Doctrine unchanged.

research_institution_foundations.next: Execute research missions — do not expand platform infrastructure

constitutional_case_law_model.reader_outcome: Future readers inspect not only the conclusion but why the conclusion survived review

phase_2_real_deliverable.note: Trust arises because scrutiny is visible — not because readers agree with every conclusion.

falsifiability_standard.title: Proof Packet Falsifiability Standard
falsifiability_standard.text: Every proof packet should be capable of disproving the doctrine it examines.
falsifiability_standard.purpose: Honestly answer whether the evidence supports, qualifies, or contradicts the architectural hypothesis — not to prove the architecture correct.
falsifiability_standard.guiding_philosophy: The objective is not to defend the architecture. The objective is to discover the truth about the architecture.
each_packet_must_actively_seek: the conditions under which the proposal should not be adopted
falsifiability_standard.revision_rule: If a packet concludes that part of the architecture should be revised, that is not a failure of Constitutional Capitalism — it is evidence that the governance process is working as intended.

constitutional_symmetry_expression.architecture: stable enough to resist casual change
constitutional_symmetry_expression.scholarship: rigorous enough to challenge any assumption
constitutional_symmetry_expression.arbiter: evidence, not author preference, determines whether refinement is warranted

falsifiability_standard.methodology_note: At this stage, the methodology is as important as the conclusions it produces. PP-FF-01 validates the packet method as much as local-procurement substance.
falsifiability_standard.next_major_achievement: PP-FF-01 executive draft delivered (Qualifies, Low confidence). Next: register contrary literature; Internal/Methodology Review; PP-02 using the same OS.
priority_work: Register contrary external literature before raising PP-FF-01 confidence
Advance PP-FF-01 through Internal / Methodology Review
Execute next proof packet (PP-FF-02 or scoped PP-02) on the same OS

three_kinds_of_truth.rule: Keep empirical, normative, and design disagreements separate in every proof packet and review.

kinds.title: Design judgment
kinds.question: Assuming our values are accepted, what institutional design best advances them?

example.empirical: Community ownership can increase local capital formation (evidence question)
example.normative: Whether it should receive preferential incentives (values question)
example.design: Which implementation mechanism to use (institutional design question)

living_community_laboratories.rule: Complementary to proof packets. Packets test doctrines; laboratories test multi-doctrine interaction in one place. PP-FF-01 remains immediate priority.

rural_prosperity_campus.rule: Major research hypothesis under falsifiability standard. Not doctrine. Empirical questions only until evidence graduates.

local_democratic_campaign_finance.rule: Major research hypothesis under falsifiability standard. Not doctrine and not a principle. Supports / Qualifies / Contradicts only. Eliminating dark money ≠ eliminating spending; locality ≠ ban on out-of-state speech; disclosure ≠ capture. CC-CLAIM-003 remains Not Enough Evidence.

distributed_civic_commons.rule: Major cultural-layer research hypothesis under falsifiability standard. Not doctrine and not a principle. Hard boundary: participation as civic duty; political rights must never depend on participation. Civic Record ≠ government score. Civic connectivity ≠ party registration. Productive disagreement = participation. Failure modes required. Converges with journalism + HYP-125.

age_16_local_suffrage.rule: Major comparative empirical track under falsifiability. Not doctrine and not a principle. Local suffrage first. Four propositions (capability/participation/habit/system) may graduate separately. Newark failure-mode kept visible. Education-before-enfranchisement sequencing is a test, not a lock. Converges with HYP-126.

civic_engagement_community_structure.rule: Major connective empirical track under falsifiability. Not doctrine, not a principle, not a baseline Community Health Index. Descriptive co-variation before causation. Turnout level ≠ volatility ≠ persistence ≠ trust. Supports HYP-125/126/127 as environment/control context. Does not displace baseline definition-locks.

arkansas_transition_framework.rule: Bridge from diagnosis to implementation. First packets scaffolded. WHY_THIS_CAN_START_NOW mandatory. Implementation ladder retained. Eligibility scan ≠ award. Not doctrine. Does not displace baseline definition-locks.

arkansas_strategic_capacity_audit.rule: Inventory scaffold: has → needs → imports → lacks → buildable. Central leave-state question locked. Shortage dials ≠ proof a program is absent. Not a completed census. Feeds HYP-129. Does not displace baseline definition-locks.

phase2_development_wave_priority.rule: Three workstreams executed as coordinated wave. Overall % must not inflate; held at 43. Remaining 24 compare systems = controlled backlog. Structural active slice remains definition-locks.

arkansas_transition_milestone_chain.rule: Operating milestone with coordinated wave executed: measurement language → capacity needs → intervention packets. Interesting story is chain progress, not overall percent.

comparative_systems_shared_dial_architec.rule: Harmonization Pass 1 complete: reusable matrix with C/S/missing markers for 16 systems. Not a ranking. Remaining 24 = controlled backlog.

coordinated_development_wave.rule: Dependency chain: shared-dial harmonization → Arkansas capability map → intervention/funding packets. WHY_THIS_CAN_START_NOW required. Overall % held at 43.

arkansas_capacity_feasibility_wave.rule: Fill architecture with Arkansas facts. Build the state by proving it locally. Existence ≠ scale. No locked site. Overall % held at 43 until pilots and verified eligibility earn credit.

arkansas_empirical_grounding_wave.rule: Correlation and pattern discovery first. County×Year observations with provenance. Votes ≠ turnout rate without denominator. No causal model. No locked site. Overall % held at 43 as honesty hold — not wave failure; the longitudinal layer is foundational infrastructure for higher-order analysis.

arkansas_empirical_depth_wave.rule: Observation first. Preserve prior provenance when adding ACS. Educational capacity ≠ employment demand. Internal explorer ≠ public score. No site lock. 43% honesty hold.

arkansas_empirical_integration_wave.rule: Integration not architecture. Counterexamples privileged. No shortage from low completions. Statewide ADWS ≠ county gap. 43% dial held until validated comparative diagnosis earns credit.

ai_research_intelligence_layer.rule: Research-ops precursor above evidence warehouse — not Phase 9 SIE activation. Server-side OPENAI_API_KEY only. AI may observe/compare/question/summarize/recommend; must not invent evidence, alter baseline, publish, or inflate dial. Completion Advancement Map explains 43→50→60 without raising percent. AI proposes; project decides.

repository_hardening.rule: UI polish cycle closed. Validate before inventing. No claim source invention. No baseline auto-fills. No dial inflation. Empirical depth and AI operation precede modeling and legal expansion.

arkansas_registered_voter_multiyear.rule: EAVS 2016–2024 registration stocks for designated counties. Election-type labels required. CVAP turnout ≠ registered turnout. SOS daily rolls still NEE. No causal model. 43% dial held.

prosperity_revenue_replacement.rule: KEEP_AS_HYPOTHESIS. Dual ledgers (IIT vs property). Inventory and legal dependency before mechanism choice. Tax retirement earned. Cited anchors require primary bind. Unmodeled prosperity returns ≠ replacement dollars. No abolish-today. 43% dial held.

publication_pass9_structural_deepen.rule: Deepen under existing 18 panels only. QBP ≠ CB:1. Generation ≠ reliability ≠ ownership. HPSA history fail-closed. HYP-125 registration only. CC-CLAIM-003 NEE. Baseline 42/64. Dial 43%.

levels.title: Proof Packets
levels.question: Is this individual doctrine supported by the evidence?

levels.title: Living Community Laboratories
levels.question: How do multiple doctrines interact within a real community?

levels.title: Comparative Community Research
levels.question: What patterns emerge across many different communities?

levels.title: Systems Intelligence
levels.question: Only after Levels 1–3 mature does Phase 9 become truly valuable — reasoning over scholarly evidence, proof packets, real communities, comparative findings, and institutional relationships — not abstract simulations alone.

evidence_hierarchy.rule: Level 1 proof packets remain the immediate execution priority. Levels 2–4 are sequenced, not simultaneous.
